register: Second person with the written-neutral singular suffixes the catalog mostly uses (שלך, לך, אותך, אליך, which read for any gender unvocalized), gender-neutral plural imperatives in sentences (לחצו, בחרו, נסו שוב, שדרגו; the catalog's majority over לחץ/בחר/נסה), and verbal nouns for buttons, menu items and titles (שמירה, הוספת אתר, סימון כנקרא). Masculine-default imperatives (שמור, לחץ, נסה שוב) and plural possessives (שלכם) are both standard in Israeli apps and are not flagged on their own; flagged are second-person slash hedges (בחר/י, נסה/י, את/ה: 58 in the catalog, low register), feminine-only forms, and one string that switches between singular and plural address mid-sentence (low register). Third-person slash forms for other users (%1$s שיתף/ה) are the normal Hebrew convention for an unknown gender and are left alone. Verifier addition: first-person hedges with no neutral verb form («אני צריך/ה להתחבר») are left alone rather than replaced by a masculine-only form.

terms.note: Catalog ~950 כתבה vs ~170 סיפור. סיפור for a story → low terminology; medium when it is a label, folder or view name whose siblings use כתבות (Saved stories, Shared stories, Next unread story). פריט is fine where English says item. Also avoid where it means this concept: פריט.
Consistent.

Catalog 273 פיד vs 152 עדכון vs 104 הזנה. עדכון/עדכונים reads as update(s) → medium terminology on labels (Feeds, Feed list, Add feed) and low in prose; הזנה is the formal Academy word, understood → low terminology. מקור is fine where the English means source. Also avoid where it means this concept: מקור.
Feature name; עדכוני רשת → medium on titles, low in prose.
Consistent.

terms.use: לא נקרא (filter label) / שלא נקראו (stories that are unread) / לא נקראו בלבד
terms.note: Unread+Focus: «לא נקראו + מיקוד».

terms.use: סימון כנקרא / סימון הכול כנקרא (button); לסמן כנקרא? (question)
terms.note: Masculine imperative סמן is accepted in buttons; not flagged.
קריאת כתבות = reading stories (verbal noun/imperative) → high meaning. Siri/Spotlight 'Read %@' opens a feed: «קריאת %@» is fine there. Also avoid where it means this concept: קריאת כתבות.

terms.use: כתבות שמורות; שמירה (button); ביטול שמירה (Unsave); נשמר (status)
terms.note: Save as rescue (הצלה) would be high.

terms.use: שיתוף (button) / כתבות ששותפו or כתבות משותפות
terms.note: Both shared-stories forms are accepted.
Product name stays Latin. בלוג טשטוש/מטושטש/ערפול = blurry/obscured blog → medium meaning. «בלוג Blur» splits the name → low. Descriptive «הבלוג שלך» / «בלוג השיתופים שלך» in prose is tolerated.

terms.use: מאמן הבינה / אימון הבינה; Train → אימון
terms.note: מודיעין is military/espionage intelligence → medium meaning. אינטליגנציה and «המערכת החכמה» are understood and left alone. Also avoid where it means this concept: מודיעין.
Consistent.

terms.use: מיקוד; Focus stories → כתבות במיקוד (כתבות ממוקדות accepted); Focus mode → מצב מיקוד
terms.note: מועדפים = favorites → medium meaning. התמקדות in a label → low.

terms.use: אהבתי / לא אהבתי; Hide (the level above Like, formerly Super Dislike) → הסתרה
terms.note: First-person past tense is gender-neutral; לא אוהב is masculine present → low terminology. «לא אוהב במיוחד» = not particularly fond (weaker, not stronger) → medium meaning. Trainer question (reader_classifier.js make_like_dislike_title / TrainerView.swift, the lowercase like/dislike words are used only there): template «מה %(like)s ומה %(dislike)s בכתבה הזו?» with like «אהבת», dislike «לא אהבת»; iOS «מה 👍 %1$@ ומה 👎 %2$@ בכתבה הזו?».

Hide is the strongest training level, above Like and Dislike (it was called Super dislike): a story that matches it is always hidden, whatever else it matches. Use the same word as the Hide button in the training controls, and quote it in sentences like the other level names (״הסתרה״ גוברת על הכול). The old Super dislike names are retired.
Trainer level separator: Like outranks Dislike.

terms.concept: Premium / Premium Archive / Premium Pro / Archive / Pro
terms.use: Premium, Premium Archive, Premium Pro, Archive, Pro (Latin); מינוי Premium; משתמשי Premium; תכונת Premium; שדרוג ל־Premium Archive
terms.note: Plan names stay Latin. פרימיום transliteration → low terminology. Premium Archive translated as «ארכיון פרימיום/ארכיון Premium» reads as 'the premium archive' → medium terminology. Archive plan as «ארכיון» (the archive) → medium. The story archive feature stays «ארכיון».

terms.use: העדפות (NewsBlur's Preferences screen on all platforms) / הגדרות (where English says Settings)
terms.note: Consistent.

terms.use: הרשמה / הירשמו (to a feed); מינוי (paid subscription); מנוי / מנויים (subscribers)
terms.note: Feed subscription can also be «מינוי»; email Unsubscribe must say emails («ביטול ההרשמה לאימיילים»), not the paid plan.

terms.concept: River of News / All Site Stories
terms.note: Singular-site readings («כל הכתבות באתר», «כל כתבות האתר») → high meaning. נהר (literal river) → low. Also avoid where it means this concept: כל כתבות האתר.
לוח מחוונים in alt text tolerated.

terms.use: תדריך יומי / התדריך; Briefing settings → הגדרות התדריך
terms.note: Catalog 59 תדריך vs 37 תקציר. תקציר (summary) for the briefing → low terminology (medium on the feature's own titles). Brief (summary length option) → «קצר/תמציתי», must not collide with the briefing.
תג tolerated.
עלון/עלוני חדשות also natural; not flagged.
Consistent.

terms.use: מעקב / עוקבים / במעקב; Follow (button) → מעקב or עקוב; Following (button state and count/tab) → במעקב; I'm Following / Following Me tabs → «אני עוקב/ת» or «במעקב» vs «עוקבים אחריי»
terms.note: Following → «עוקב» collides with Follower «עוקב» → medium.

terms.concept: Follow up (Ask AI box) / Follow-ups (briefing section)
terms.note: The Ask AI input placeholder asks a follow-up question; «מעקב…» = tracking → medium meaning.

terms.use: השתקה / ביטול השתקה; Muted → מושתק; Mute None → ביטול השתקת הכול
terms.note: Mute None selects none of the sites to mute.
Consistent.
Stories from sites that post rarely; versions that make the stories themselves rare → low terminology.

terms.concept: Good Reads / Long Reads / Widely Read / Global Shared
terms.use: קריאות מומלצות (קריאות טובות accepted) / כתבות ארוכות (קריאות ארוכות accepted) / כתבות שנקראו רבות / כתבות משותפות גלובליות
terms.note: Good Reads is a folder of good stories, not books or reviews → high meaning.

terms.use: תצוגת טקסט / תצוגת כתבה / תצוגת פיד / תצוגת האתר המקורי
שאלו את ה-AI (also accepted: שאל את ה-AI, שאלו את הבינה המלאכותית); in a sentence ״שאלו את ה-AI״
terms.note: Catalog 22 translated vs 14 Latin; a descriptive feature name is translated. Latin «Ask AI» in UI → medium untranslated.

terms.concept: account / log in / sign up / log out

terms.note: Split evenly in the catalog; both standard, not flagged.
«שדרוג מ־Premium» (Upgrade from) is fine: שדרוג implies moving up.

terms.use: web gettext nplurals=2: :0 = one (n == 1, singular noun: «%(count)s אתר», «%(count)s כתבה»), :1 = other (plural noun). iOS stringsdict and Android: one / two / other; two may use the plural noun with the number («%d ימים») or the dual.
avoid: noun before the number in the one form («אתר %(count)s» reads as 'site no. 1')
terms.note: Plural noun in a one form → medium grammar; «%(count)s» moved after the noun → medium.

terms.use: Western punctuation; quotes ״…״ when adding new ones (never ASCII "); maqaf ־ or hyphen before Latin/placeholders after a prefix letter (ל־Premium, ב-%s), either accepted; ellipsis as in the source
terms.note: No invisible bidi control characters added.

terms.use: Use %(language)s / %1$s / %@ → «השתמשו ב־%1$s» (accepted: the maqaf prefix works for Latin and Hebrew names; web «שימוש ב־%(language)s» also fine). Detected → «NewsBlur זיהה במכשיר/בדפדפן שלכם את השפה %1$s.»
terms.note: The picker inserts any language's native name (Deutsch, עברית), so a prefix with maqaf is the safe form; «זיהה את עברית» reads oddly → low unnatural.

terms.use: web «לפני %(time)s» with bare units «%(number)d ימים/יום» (Hebrew does not inflect the count after לפני); future «בעוד %(time)s»
terms.note: reader_statistics.js 'Next Update' + «in %(time)s» should be «בעוד %(time)s».
«מערכתי» reads as systemic to most readers; «מאמר מערכת» is the Hebrew name of the editorial genre, and the subtitle explains the narrative style. Applied on web, iOS and Android.

terms.use: הפעל כבא בתור / הפעל בסוף התור
terms.note: story_detail_view.js add_to_queue(item, 0) / add_to_queue(item); imperative to match the sibling «הפעל בנגן מדיה מוקטן».

«ביטול המינוי» reads as cancelling the paid plan and «ביטול ההרשמה» can read as cancelling the account; «הסרה מרשימת התפוצה» is the standard Israeli email footer wording. Also avoid where it means this concept: ביטול ההרשמה.
